respondeo-opening.text: As stated above (I-II:88:1; I-II:88:2), mortal sin is so called because it destroys the spiritual life which is the effect of charity, whereby God dwells in us. Wherefore any sin which by its very nature is contrary to charity is a mortal sin by reason of its genus. And such is sloth, because the proper effect of charity is joy in God ...
respondeo-opening.notes: q.35 sits among the vices opposed to joy (q.28), an effect of charity. Hatred (q.34) is the vice most directly opposed to charity itself.
